positioning: I build ML systems and LLM agents end to end, from the model to the interface people use, and run them in production. [EDIT]
location: Based in Bengaluru, open to relocation or remote [EDIT]
impact: I cut inference p95 latency from 820 ms to 190 ms at 500 requests per second, measured with k6 on the same hardware, by adding dynamic batching and a response cache to the gateway. [EDIT]
I raised a support agent's task success from 61% to 84% on a 400-task labelled eval set by adding retrieval over resolved tickets and tool-call guardrails. [EDIT]
I reduced escaped visual defects by 38% over a quarter of line data by training and shipping a segmentation model with drift monitoring. [EDIT]
